How to Evaluate a BIM Engineer’s Technical Skills

CVs and interviews overstate BIM skills. A structured evaluation with a practical task shows what a BIM engineer can actually produce.

Most BIM hiring decisions are made on a CV and an interview. Both reward confident communication more than modelling ability. A structured technical evaluation fixes that, and it does not need to take more than half a day.

What to evaluate

Software proficiency

Test the tools the role uses, in the version your project uses. For a Revit modeler that means modelling, families, view templates and sheets; for a coordinator, Navisworks clash tests, grouping and viewpoints; for infrastructure, Civil 3D corridors and surfaces.

Standards

Give the candidate a short extract of a BEP and naming convention and see whether they apply it unprompted. Ask what ISO 19650 status codes mean and how they would handle a model that fails a naming check.

Coordination judgement

Show a set of clashes and ask which to resolve first and how. Strong candidates distinguish real conflicts from tolerance noise, route gravity drainage before pressurised services and know who should move.

Documentation

Ask for a sheet from the model with correct annotation and a schedule. Clean documentation shows an understanding of what the model is for.

The practical task

The most informative part is a timed exercise that reproduces a real task: model a small area to a given LOD, resolve a set of clashes, or build a parametric family. Review it against a checklist you wrote before the test, not against your impression afterwards.

Scoring

Score each area separately, record the evidence and the date, and keep mandatory skills apart from preferred ones. A candidate who misses a mandatory skill should not pass on the strength of others. Writing the result down makes the decision explainable to the project team.

How ENGISOFT does it

Our technical assessment combines experience verification, a software test, a technical interview, a practical BIM task, portfolio review where permitted and a communication check. The results go into a competency passport that clients see with each shortlisted profile.
